evidence.text: First-time setup today needs separate commands and approvals: declare keys, plan structure, approve, apply, import values, add targets, grant access.
The owner wants setup to be as ergonomic as possible, ideally one review and one approval.
Every write to 1Password and to deployment targets must be approved by a person; approvals bind a content hash of the exact plan.

worseningOutcome: Safety and precision of consent: one broad approval risks approving writes the person did not examine
